Container.Name: Silo
Container.Overview:
Silo is a self-hosted media streaming server for your movies, shows, music and books. Point it at your media folders and stream to your devices - at home or away - with direct play, remuxing and hardware-accelerated transcoding handled automatically.
A full-featured web client and admin interface ship with the server. An optional Jellyfin/Emby-compatible API lets you keep using clients you already own, such as Infuse, VidHub and Findroid. Household profiles give each member their own watch state and parental controls, and metadata is matched through installable plugins including TMDB and TVDB.
IMPORTANT: Silo needs a PostgreSQL 18 database with the pgvector extension and Redis 6.2 or newer. Install the Silo-PostgreSQL template from this repository, then install any generic Redis container from Community Applications or use an existing Redis service. Set DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL below to point at them.
Hardware transcoding is optional. If your Unraid server exposes /dev/dri, set the advanced Hardware Transcoding device field to /dev/dri to use an Intel or AMD GPU.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: silo media server streaming movies tv shows music audiobooks jellyfin emby plex transcode
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL 18 with the pgvector extension and Redis 6.2 or newer must be running before Silo will start. Install Silo-PostgreSQL from this repository and any generic Redis container from Community Applications, or use an existing Redis service. A SECRET_KEY is also required - generate one with: openssl rand -base64 48

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Silo web interface and API.

Config.Name: Jellyfin-Compatible API Port
Config.Description: Port for the optional Jellyfin/Emby-compatible API, used by clients such as Infuse, VidHub and Findroid. Disabled until an administrator enables it in admin settings. Change this if you already run Jellyfin on 8096.

Config.Name: Audiobookshelf-Compatible API Port
Config.Description: Port for the optional Audiobookshelf-compatible API. Change this if you already run Audiobookshelf on 13378.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your media library. Mounted read-only - Silo never writes to your media. Point this at the share holding your movies, shows and music.

Config.Name: Books
Config.Description: Books and audiobooks library, if you keep it outside your main media share. Mounted read-only.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: All persistent Silo application data, including installed plugins and compatibility assets. Back this directory up together with PostgreSQL and SECRET_KEY.

Config.Name: Transcode Scratch
Config.Description: Temporary transcode files. Defaults to /tmp, which is RAM on Unraid - this avoids unnecessary SSD wear. Point it at a cache-backed path instead if you have limited RAM.

Config.Name: Host meminfo
Config.Description: Read-only view of host memory, used to auto-tune database settings. Leave as-is.

Config.Name: MODE
Config.Description: Deployment mode. Leave as 'integrated' for a normal single-server install.

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Master key for at-rest credential encryption - the server will not start without it. Generate one by opening an Unraid terminal and running: openssl rand -base64 48 -- Back this up separately from your database. If you lose it, encrypted secrets cannot be recovered.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Connection string for Silo-PostgreSQL, for example: postgres://silo:YOUR-PASSWORD@YOUR-UNRAID-IP:5432/silo?sslmode=disable. The password must match POSTGRES_PASSWORD. Replace YOUR-UNRAID-IP with your Unraid server's LAN IP address and percent-encode reserved characters in the password.

Config.Name: REDIS_URL
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Connection string for Redis 6.2 or newer. Install any generic Redis container from Community Applications or use an existing Redis service, then replace YOUR-UNRAID-IP with its reachable address.

Config.Name: SILO_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR
Config.Description: Where plugins are cached inside the container. Leave as-is.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_TUNE
Config.Description: Automatically tune database connection settings based on available host memory.

Config.Name: Hardware Transcoding (iGPU)
Config.Description: Optional Intel or AMD GPU for hardware-accelerated transcoding. Set this to /dev/dri only when that device exists on the Unraid host; leave it blank for CPU-only systems.
